storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: The US Marines have canceled a planned joint military drill with South Korea, citing force constraints related to the ongoing Iran war. This decision was communicated in June, following President Trump's recent order to reduce the duration of another military exercise, the Ulchi Freedom Shield, from 11 days to five. The cancellation reflects adjustments in US military commitments amid international conflicts.
